title: Groups at once by embark size, every size: 1x1..6x6 fresh 7-dwarf embarks (FPS2E1..E6, CTRL's tile), tool on (preset), land and cavern limits at the default (land 3, cavern 2) vs sqrt(embark)+1 (N+1 for NxN); 2 reps. Per 1,500 t: surface and cavern wild groups (species x population) and units.
fork: does the limit bind, per size and layer?

predictions.expects: root+1 arms carry more concurrent groups, more so on big maps

kill_criterion: mean concurrent surface groups within 0.5 between arms at every size
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: 1x1_default
pre: dfhack.run_command('cx-load','sustain'); print('eco: sustain')
dfhack.run_command('seasonal-wildlife','preset'); print('eco: preset')

dfhack.run_command('seasonal-wildlife','quota','land','3'); dfhack.run_command('seasonal-wildlife','quota','cavern','2'); dfhack.run_command('seasonal-wildlife','enable'); local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local c=sw.loadConfig(); print(('eco: enabled=%s land=%s cavern=%s'):format(tostring(c.enabled), tostring(c.limits.land.groups), tostring(c.limits.cavern.groups)))
local X,Y=dfhack.maps.getTileSize(); print(('eco: map %dx%d tiles = %dx%d embark'):format(X,Y,X//48,Y//48))

do: dfhack.run_command('cx-load','sustain')

local g,c,gu,cu={},{},0,0; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and not u.flags1.inactive then local p=u.animal.population; local k=u.race..':'..p.population_idx; if p.cave_id~=-1 then c[k]=true; cu=cu+1 elseif p.feature_idx==-1 then g[k]=true; gu=gu+1 end end end; local ng,nc=0,0; for _ in pairs(g) do ng=ng+1 end; for _ in pairs(c) do nc=nc+1 end; print(('eco: surface wild groups %d units %d; cavern groups %d units %d'):format(ng,gu,nc,cu))
